items.title: Big pharma-backed T-Therapeutics snags $133m to bring TCEs to clinic
items.summary: T-Therapeutics will now generate proof-of-concept data for its oncology and immunology TCE drugs with “blockbuster” potential.

items.title: Podcast: An investor’s guide to preparing your clinical data package
items.summary: Biotech investor Stephan Christgau speaks about the key considerations when devising a clinical strategy that will attract investor attention.

items.title: Evommune signs $1.1bn licence deal with Hinova for EVO570
items.summary: Evommune has secured exclusive rights outside Greater China to develop EVO570 from Hinova Pharmaceuticals in a deal worth up to $1.1bn.

items.title: PharmatrophiX and Circular partner on neurodegenerative drugs
items.summary: PharmatrophiX and Circular Genomics have partnered to advance blood-based circular RNA biomarkers in neurodegenerative drug development programmes.

items.title: MSD’s non-oncology sales set to double as Keytruda faces patent cliff
items.summary: MSD’s expanding non-oncology portfolio is expected to play an increasingly important role in cushioning the impact of Keytruda’s patent cliff.
